citations.long: Adequate lab facilities for testing and approval or rejection of components and drug product containers are not available to the quality control unit.

citations.short: Procedures not  in writing, fully followed
citations.long: The responsibilities and procedures applicable to the quality control unit are not in writing.
Equipment used in the manufacture, processing, packing or holding of drug products is not of appropriate design, of adequate size, and suitably located to facilitate operations for its intended use.

Written procedures for cleaning and maintenance fail to include maintenance and cleaning schedules, description in sufficient detail of methods, equipment and materials used, description in sufficient detail of the methods of disassembling and reassembling equipment as necessary to assure proper cleaning and maintenance, and instructions for removal or obliteration of previous batch identification.
Procedures designed to prevent microbiological contamination of drug products purporting to be sterile are not written.
The written stability testing program is not followed.
Verification of the suitability of the testing methods is deficient in that they are not performed under actual conditions of use.
Laboratory records are deficient in that they do not include a complete record of all data obtained during testing.

citations.short: Calculations performed are in the records
citations.long: Laboratory records do not include a record of all calculations performed in connection with the test.

citations.short: Test method modification records not maintained
citations.long: Complete records are not maintained of any modification of an established method employed in testing.
